title: "Handle a data-access request"
description: "A controlled route from enquiry to an authorised data-sharing decision."

::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--operations}
Operations Manual
:::

## Receive and classify

1. Record the requester, organisation, purpose, population, period and requested
   variables in the authorised private register.
2. Check whether an existing approved public aggregate output meets the need.
3. If not, classify the minimum required information as aggregate,
   deidentified record-level or identifiable/linkable.
4. Identify applicable ownership, legal, ethical, confidentiality and security
   requirements.
5. Refer the request to the BNR-authorised decision route for that access class.

Do not describe record-level data as anonymous merely because direct identifiers
have been removed.

## Decide

The authorised decision must record one of these outcomes:

- direct the requester to an existing public output;
- ask for clarification or a smaller dataset;
- approve specified data and safeguards, subject to an agreement;
- refer for further ethics, legal or governance review; or
- refuse, with a recorded reason.

Approval must state the permitted purpose, people, variables, records, period,
storage, transfer, onward-sharing, output-review, retention and destruction
conditions. Complete the [Data Sharing Agreement](../data/data-governance/dsa-om.qmd)
when required.

## Prepare and release

The BNR Analyst prepares only the approved minimum dataset through controlled,
reproducible code. A second authorised check confirms dataset identity,
conditions and disclosure safety. Use the approved transfer route and record
what was supplied, when, by whom and to whom.

Never place an application, non-public dataset, agreement, credential, transfer
detail or review evidence in Git.

## Close and retain evidence

Retain the request, assessment, decision, approver, agreement, exact dataset
version, preparation record, transfer record, output decisions and
expiry/destruction evidence in the authorised private governance location.

::: {.callout-note title="BNR policy details still required"}
BNR must confirm the intake contact, decision authority by access class,
agreement signatories, service targets, authoritative register and approved
transfer methods. Until confirmed, stop and refer the request to the BNR Lead.
:::
